prompt: In which month and year did the COVID-19 toll across the world reach 1 million deaths, a number equivalent to the population of San Jose, California — the tenth largest city in the U.S. at that time?
answer:
The worldwide reported COVID-19 death toll reached **1 million in September 2020**.  

*(The U.S. alone reached 1 million reported deaths later, in May 2022—the milestone associated with the San Jose comparison.)*
